supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceGoal: Let’s use fractions to describe parts.
supplementalLessonTeachingGuidance.sourceLearningGoals: Express the area of each part as a unit fraction of the whole. Partition shapes into halves, thirds, fourths, sixths, and eighths.
teachingSteps: Identify the whole and divide it into equal parts.
Represent the fraction with a number line or equal-area drawing.
Explain the unit fractions, position, equality or comparison.
